name: Bartow
schedule: Once a year in June, first Tuesday, Bartow County Courthouse, Cartersville
note: No list is posted now. The overage file (buyers and overage only) is a rotating SharePoint link.

auction.office_address: Frank Moore Administration and Judicial Building, 135 W Cherokee Ave, Suite 217A, Cartersville, GA 30120
vital: The official pages do not publish the sale location, hours, registration or payment terms; confirm with the Tax Commissioner's office before attending.
Unpaid accounts are sent to Delinquent Tax Services Inc.; admin and levy fees are added and the property is posted and photographed before the sale.
Properties are advertised in the Daily Tribune newspaper for four weeks before the sale.
The official tax sales page currently shows no sale list.
An excess funds claim form and a Tax Sale Overage list are posted on the county Tax Commissioner page.
Georgia law (O.C.G.A. 48-4-40 to 48-4-45) gives the owner 12 months to redeem a non-judicial tax deed by paying the bid plus a 20% premium; this county's pages do not restate it.
auction.confirmed: County page shows 2026 property tax bill notice
